scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npx --prefix backend prisma db push --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx --prefix backend ts-node --project backend/tsconfig.json backend/prisma/seed.ts && npm run build --prefix frontend
